voice.welcome: Welcome to the color lab! Pick an experiment.
voice.mode-discover: Let’s mix two colors and discover a new one.
voice.mode-predict: Guess what color they will make, then test your idea.
voice.mode-recipe: Can you mix the two colors this little friend needs?
voice.discover-red-yellow: Pour red and yellow into the beaker.
voice.discover-yellow-blue: Pour yellow and blue into the beaker.
voice.discover-red-blue: Pour red and blue into the beaker.
voice.predict-red-yellow: Red and yellow are ready. Which color do you think they will make?
voice.predict-yellow-blue: Yellow and blue are ready. Which color do you think they will make?
voice.predict-red-blue: Red and blue are ready. Which color do you think they will make?
voice.predict-right-orange: You predicted orange, and you were right!
voice.predict-right-green: You predicted green, and you were right!
voice.predict-right-purple: You predicted purple, and you were right!
voice.nudge-red-yellow: We need red and yellow this time.
voice.nudge-yellow-blue: We need yellow and blue this time.
voice.nudge-red-blue: We need red and blue this time.
voice.same-red: More red stays red. Pick a different color to make a new one.
voice.same-yellow: More yellow stays yellow. Pick a different color to make a new one.
voice.same-blue: More blue stays blue. Pick a different color to make a new one.
voice.rinse: A little rinse, and we can try again.
